# Warcry timing, power, and charges

- **Status:** ✅ Confirmed
- **Skills affected:** charging_warcry, commanding_warcry, fearless_warcry, raging_warcry, resurrection_warcry, shockwave_warcry
- **Mechanic tags:** warcry, cooldown, duration, charges, uptime
- **Last verified:** 2026-09-01 by owner

## Derived / confirmed formula

Power = min(cap, max(enemy rarity count, minimum enemies)). Kragol's eight-second per-distinct-cast lines use a user-overridable count clamped to distinct equipped Warcry IDs. Its current-Warcry additional-duration line is a Warcry-only additional-duration pool scaled by resolved Power; Corroded ordinary Warcry Effect is an unconditional increased-effect source.

## Notes / caveats / open questions

Owner-approved SS13 data is modeled. Automatic Power is min(current cap, max(target enemy count, minimum affected enemies)); the same current cap constrains a manual Power override. Distinct Warcry skills apply together; only duplicate copies of the same Warcry require a selected most-recent slot. Resurrection's final Additional Damage Taken contribution is capped at -60% after Warcry Effect, while its fixed restoration amount is spread over its generically duration-scaled four-second window. Charging Warcry's Tracking Area is a dedicated Shadow Strike contribution: owner confirmed it is 20% scaled by Warcry Effect but not Warcry Power, with Distance = 9.5 m × (1 + total tracking contribution), not general Skill Area. The default/simple description is the level-1 value; a differing detailed value is the level-20 endpoint, interpolated through level 20. SS13 exposes only a Combo tag, so Shockwave's finisher damage temporarily applies to the whole Combo skill until sequence/cast-position modeling exists.

## Implementation (engine model)

engine/warcry.py creates timing/contribution summaries and injects each Warcry into its existing scoped or global stat pool. compute.py derives automatic power and Shockwave stacks, applies Full/Real uptime to persistent buffs, and schedules Resurrection restoration on its resolved cooldown. The Calcs Warcry panel uses those summaries.
